plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 15% to favor income and broad index exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce overall leverage.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy KLAC at 4% as a new position, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some tech exposure with reduced leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly growth by blending broad index, quality tech, and a small amount of leverage. It aims for moderate risk, with potential for drawdowns in market corrections.

plan: Add to SOXL to 7%, SPAL to 6%, MUU to 6%, and METU to 6% to increase leveraged exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Buy KLAC at 6% as a new position, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
Add to CRWD to 10%, pressing into a high-performing asset.
This plan aggressively leans into high-scoring setups and leveraged ETFs for growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by maximizing leveraged exposure and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, CRWD, and SNOW to zero, eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30% to prioritize income and covered-call strategies.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions with lower volatility.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
